Who they are

OpenArt is an AI creative studio for generating and editing AI images and video — text-to-image/video with 100+ models (Seedance, GPT Image, MiniMax, Gemini), character & world consistency, an AI-influencer generator, Director Mode for full films, brand kits, and VFX / relight / lip-sync. 'Your studio, your controls' — trusted by 8M+ creators.
